title: Rabbi Tanchum bar Pappa

paragraphs: Jerusalem Talmud Kiddushin 3:11 relates that he sent and asked Rabbi Yose about two cases from Alexandria, one concerning an unmarried woman and one a married woman, and Rabbi Yose instructed Rabbi Mana, his student, to sign the reply. Hyman identifies this Rabbi Yose as Rabbi Yonah’s colleague and not Rabbi Assi; he says Erekh Milin erred about this under the entry Alexandria, and Mavo HaYerushalmi is right.

notes.text: The supplied עוברין literally suggests embryos; saved Guggenheimer Jerusalem Talmud Kiddushin 3:12 instead reads עובדין, two cases, one concerning an unmarried woman and one a married woman. The English follows that established contextual sense while the original Hebrew and supplied 3:11 locator remain preserved. Hyman’s historical identification and bibliographical criticism stay attributed.
